reason: chatsAPI.list only converts deprecated page/perPage input and delegates; it performs no pagination validation, so the 'handles validation' clause misstates its behavior.
protobuf-go maps Go fields by protobuf tag number, not declaration order; placing Reason last is generator convention, not a requirement.
PyQt5 5.15.1 binding returns Tuple[QVersionNumber, int], not a single QVersionNumber; right function, wrong return behavior.
Holds only for {}; null is rejected by the short-circuiting !data clause and never reaches hasOwnProperty, yet the claim covers both inputs.
Defaulting observation is right, but changing the controller is not required; API-layer or route-middleware validation could raise invalid-data. Necessity misstated.
Baseline has no strict-mode branch, no DiffPlus constant and no DiffStatus field; the quoted code references nonexistent objects recalled from upstream.
True only for authorized callers with valid pagination; unauthorized raw-message calls return not-allowed and missing pagination returns invalid-data.
Baseline VulnInfo struct (CveID through VulnType) has no DiffStatus field or diffStatus JSON tag; the named field does not exist.
Postgres migration driver locks via pg_advisory_lock, unlike the CockroachDB lock-table driver; issue requires CockroachDB driver selection, so not a viable bridge.
migrate.Up always calls the Postgres driver's pg_advisory_lock before migrating, not CockroachDB's lock-table mechanism, so working migrations are not assured.
Skip check is uniform, but googledocs sets explicit name ua-googledocs instead of generated js-googledocs; universal naming claim has an exception.
go-redis v9 picks unix when Addr starts with '/', tcp otherwise; the tcp default holds only for non-slash addresses.
No loadStructInfo in protobuf v1.28.1; makeStructInfo builds fieldsByNumber from tags and matches descriptor fields by number, not order.
Holds only for nonzero patch releases; strings like 5.4.0 or 5.15.0 parse to unnormalized QVersionNumbers, so normalization must be applied explicitly.
Mapping cockroach schemes to Postgres plus adding a CockroachDB constant lacks an identity-preserving parse/selection step, so the constant is never produced.
Open indeed takes no options, but parse(cfg, opts options) also accepts options; the 'only open' exclusivity leaves out parse.
chatsAPI.list only converts truthy deprecated page input and forwards start/stop; it has no validation or invalid-data branch.
config_stub builds a real Config; assignments go through _set_value and FlagList validation, so valid values are enforced, not bypassed.
Mechanism omits handling for unmatched current results (appended unfiltered, unmarked), and the recalled minus-only helper writes into a nil map.
disintegration/imaging has v1.6.2 (Nov 2019), newer than v1.6.1, and the baseline pins v1.6.2; version misstated.
Defaults must be accepted, but the issue also requires customized Redis settings (e.g., TLS, pool size) be accepted; claim leaves those out.
Lists only fixture ports 6379/6378; schema port is any integer and ports like 6380 are valid, so valid cases are left out.
Wire compatibility does not make migration drivers interchangeable; Postgres driver uses pg_advisory_lock while the pinned CockroachDB driver uses a lock table.
Baseline diff iterates only current CVEs; previous-only (fixed) CVEs are never added and no +/- markers exist, so -diff behavior is misstated.
Baseline RedisCacheConfig and closed schema have only host, port, password, db; pool_size, min_idle_conns, conn_max_idle_time, net_timeout do not exist.
Issue requires square=true output regardless of resizing; restricting square to size>0 leaves out non-resize and source-fits cases.
QVersionNumber operator>= and operator== directly express the required non-exact and exact checks; plain comparisons are usable.
at(NaN) normalizes the index to 0 and returns the receiver's first element, not the numeric value 0.
The <6.3 predicate is right, but a new quirk is not necessary; direct MainWorld injection via existing _inject_js could implement it.
CountDiff does not exist at baseline and FormatCveSummary has no CountDiff call or diff-mode branch; the claimed usage location is fictitious.
stubClient returns a plain object cast to MatrixClient; omitted methods are undefined, so calling them throws TypeError rather than returning undefined.
Literal status === 'dnd' check lives in server-side SocketModules.chats.isDnD; HEAD route compares against the :status param. Check attributed to wrong location.
Holds only if the package was removed; a CVE resolved by upgrade leaves its package in current.Packages, so absence is not implied.
An empty readable directory satisfies the file source; copies may be needed for actual migrations, not for the directory to exist.
protoc-gen-go v1.28.1 seeds goTypes with all file enums/messages first, then dependencies; not ordered by resolver references.
usersAPI.getStatus always returns an object { status }; only the status property can be null, not the return value.
With --diff, TUI loads ordinary results (skipping _diff.json) and FillCveInfos calls diff; it computes differences rather than reading pre-generated JSON.
DSN does default to sslmode=disable, but lib/pq treats that as no SSL, contradicting the claimed secure-default requirement.
Non-public newRoom calls addSystemMessage('user-join'), persisting a system message and incrementing the count; the claim denies any message is sent.
Baseline diff signature takes only curResults and preResults; mode, plus and minus parameters do not exist (recalled from upstream).
